verdict.rationale: The privacy-posture axis applies, since Insomnia ships AI features such as AI mock generation and AI commit messages. However, nothing in the pack documents an AI-training opt-out or a policy against training on user data. The only related evidence is adjacent storage controls: end-to-end encrypted sync, Git Sync, Local Vault and login-free Scratch Pad. These do not address model training, so they earn no credit.
